READ_ME_FIRST: This is the complete product catalog of the United Dispo store (now live at uniteddispo.com), exported on 2026-11-18 from the original Shopify store (unidispo.com). All 20 products are included: 17 active and 3 archived.
Only products with status 'active' and a value in 'shown_on_homepage' appear on the homepage today. Archived products are hidden from shoppers on Shopify; don't show them.
Prices are in USD. Every product has one price for all of its variants. No product is on sale (no compare-at prices).

Strains: for most cartridges and disposables the variant option is literally named 'Options' in Shopify, and its values are the strain types (Hybrid / Sativa / Indica). Some products use upper case (HYBRID / SATIVA / INDICA). Display them consistently.
Flavors: GEEK BAR PULSE X uses an option named 'FLAVOR' with 24 values.
Stock: when 'inventory_tracked' is false, Shopify doesn't count stock, so every variant is sellable and inventory_quantity is null. When it's true, a variant is sold out at 0.

'description_html' is the product description, cleaned of junk attributes copied from ChatGPT (data-start/data-end) and inline white-text spans. 'description_lines' is the same text without tags. Descriptions are short feature lists; many are reused across products.
Images are on Shopify's image server (cdn.shopify.com). They stop working if the Shopify store is closed, so download them into the new site.
'buy_links' are Shopify custom fields. Only 2 products have any, and every one is https://www.youtube.com/ (a placeholder). See 'product_page_layout' for how the live product page uses them.
Each product's 'notes' list problems found in the data. Ask the store owner before changing product names, prices or descriptions.

Store-wide context: age-restricted products (21+), nicotine warning required: 'WARNING: Products included in this website contains nicotine. Nicotine is an addictive chemical.' (wording as it appears on the current site's age gate).

product_page_layout.summary: How the current Shopify product page (templates/product.json, Dawn-based theme) is laid out, so a rebuilt page can match it.

page.fonts: Headings Oswald 500; body Avenir Next 500 (fallback Helvetica Neue, Arial). Same as the homepage.
page.spacing: 36px above the product section, 12px below (75% of that on phones).

media_column.position: Left on desktop, above the info on phones
media_column.size: Medium (the info column is wider than a 'large' layout would allow)
media_column.gallery: Main image with thumbnail strip underneath; thumbnails hidden on phones (swipe instead)
media_column.image_fit: contain (whole image visible, no cropping), constrained to the screen height
media_column.sticky: The info column stays in view while scrolling past tall images

info_column_blocks_in_order.notes: Shows nothing: there's no reviews app installed.
e.g. '$35.99 USD' (the theme shows the currency code).
Clickable pill buttons (rounded, 40px corner radius), one per strain or flavor. Sold-out variants are shown crossed out/disabled.
Shows 'Low stock' when 10 or fewer are left and 'In stock' otherwise, without showing the number. Only meaningful when inventory is tracked.

Full-width gold gradient link (linear-gradient(180deg, #E8C766, #BA9930)), text #111, 600 weight, 16px, 1px #FFD700 border, 4px radius, 14px vertical padding, 20px top margin, shadow 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.2). Hover: gradient #FFD976 to #C8A732 and shadow 0 4px 12px rgba(212,175,55,.35). Opens the product's custom field 'external_link' in a new tab.
Centered under the button, 8px gap: green lock icon (#10b981) and 'Checkout secured by Shopify / Whop' (gray #9ca3af, 12.5px; 'Shopify / Whop' bold green).
'Share' button that copies the page link.

related_products_section.heading: YOU MAY ALSO LIKE
related_products_section.heading_size: h1 (same size as the homepage grid headings)
related_products_section.cards: Same card design as the homepage product grid, portrait images, second image on hover, no add-to-cart button on the cards.

problems_on_the_live_page: There is no Add to cart button: the theme's buy-buttons block isn't on the product page. The only way to buy is 'Buy it now'.

'Buy it now' reads the custom field 'external_link'. Only ACE ULTRA PREMIUM and Boutiq Switch V5 have it, and both point to https://www.youtube.com/. On the other 18 products the button has no link and goes nowhere.

The theme also has a script that sends Add to cart / checkout clicks to a different custom field, 'external_buy_url'. Only ACE ULTRA PREMIUM has it (also youtube.com). Pick one field for buy links on the new site.
The page has a quantity selector, but the external buy link has no way to receive the chosen quantity or strain.

The theme CSS would also add '🔒 Secured by PayPal' under a buy-buttons block. It doesn't show today because that block is missing, but it contradicts 'Checkout secured by Shopify / Whop'. Use one payment message.
